introduction.text: I'm Navid Zare, a Full-Stack Developer from Shiraz, Iran, with about two years of production experience — React and Next.js as my specialty, and Node.js, Express, and MongoDB / PostgreSQL for the back end. I'm completing an M.Sc. in AI Engineering at Shiraz University alongside full-time work. Right now I care most about writing web apps that load fast, hold up under real use, and stay maintainable.

currentWork.text: I work at ARPut as the front-end developer on two production sites — ARPutMarket (Next.js, with server-side rendering for SEO and first-load performance) and the main ARPut site (vanilla JS/HTML/CSS, no frameworks). Alongside those, I designed and built an internal admin dashboard end-to-end: UI/UX, JWT authentication, and the Node.js/Express back end, plus a full blog-management module built on a deeply customized Tiptap editor (Aparat and YouTube embeds, image embedding, alignment controls, Persian RTL support).

sideWork.text: Outside of work, I've built two full-stack MERN projects end-to-end: Forever, an e-commerce store with a separate React storefront, Express REST API, and admin panel (Auth0, Cloudinary, Stripe), and QuickBlog, a blog platform with AI-driven content generation via the Gemini API, JWT auth, and moderated comments.

howIWork.text: I like problems where the requirements aren't fully specified yet and I have to decide what's actually worth building.
howIWork.tradeoff: One thing I've learned about myself: I'll happily disappear into an optimization or an abstraction that a simpler approach would have covered. I'm getting better at asking whether the work is earning its keep before I start it.

outsideWork.text: Outside of code: guitar🎸, swimming🏊‍♂️, and drawing✏️. I also spent two years in content creation before moving into web development🌐.
